activities.activity_description: Develop Spring Cloud Stream binder for Azure Event Hubs to support read/write operations as per U1.
Integrate Spring XD with IPython Notebook for interactive data computations as per U2.
Ensure upgrade of Spring XD preserves specified directories and configuration files as per U3.
Provide option to direct bind modules without messaging middleware to reduce latency as per U4.
Expose REST APIs to interact with xd-admin for CRUD operations on streaming and batch pipelines as per U5.
Develop stubs for ModuleRegistry to enable mock streams via registry APIs as per U6.
Migrate modules from s-c-s to s-c repo, including source code and build changes as per U7.
Provide in-memory repository for stream definitions to simplify development without persistence as per U8.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all implemented features to ensure compatibility and correctness.
Update user guides, API documentation, and migration notes for the new features.
Initialize development environment, configure build scripts, and set up dependencies for the increment.
